steps.en: Install the app from the App Store (iOS) or the APK from GitHub Releases (Android)
steps.zh: iOS 装 App Store 版，Android 装 GitHub 的 APK

steps.en: Unpacks a bundled Alpine Linux rootfs and boots it inside the app
steps.zh: 解开内置的 Alpine Linux 根文件系统，在应用里启动它

steps.en: Add a model: paste your own API key or sign in to a provider account
steps.zh: 接一个模型：填自己的 API key，或登录服务商账号

steps.en: Ask in chat, or send it something from the Share Sheet or a Shortcut
steps.zh: 在聊天里提要求，或从分享菜单、快捷指令把东西丢给它

steps.en: Runs the agent loop: the model plans, then installs packages and runs scripts in the sandbox
steps.zh: 跑 agent 循环：模型做计划，在沙箱里装包、跑脚本

steps.en: Hands Health, Calendar, Reminders and HomeKit calls to native code and writes the result
steps.zh: 把健康、日历、提醒事项、HomeKit 调用交给原生代码，写回结果

value.en: You describe a phone errand once and it lands in Health, Calendar or Reminders — no laptop, no server to keep running
value.zh: 一句话交代手机上的杂事，结果直接落进健康、日历或提醒事项——不用开电脑，也不用养一台服务器

Share Sheet and Shortcuts)
